title: Pi & printers
description: The in-store hardware per store: each Pi's version, heartbeat, disk, temperature and SD card, printer status and failures, tablets, SSE reconnects and the POS link.

list.name: pg
list.label: Store database
list.description: Follows env: pg-prod / pg-staging (no Postgres datasource for dev).

list.name: store
list.label: Store
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT tenant AS __value, store_name AS __text FROM reporting.stores ORDER BY 2
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT tenant AS __value, store_name AS __text FROM reporting.stores ORDER BY 2

panels.title: Pis reporting
panels.description: Pis that sent a heartbeat in the last 5 minutes (unlinked Pis included).

targets.expr: count(max by (tenant, service_instance_id) ({__name__=~"agent_disk_free(_bytes)?", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|unlinked|"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Pis gone quiet
panels.description: Pis seen in the last 24 h that have not reported for 5+ minutes. Red: that store's orders cannot ring or print — power-cycle the Pi; if it does not come back, follow deploy/pi/RECOVERY.md.

targets.expr: count((time() - max by (tenant, service_instance_id) (max_over_time(timestamp({__name__=~"agent_disk_free(_bytes)?", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|unlinked|"})[1d:1m]))) > 300) or vector(0)

panels.title: Printers down
panels.description: Printers the Pis currently probe as unreachable. Tickets reroute (REROUTED banner) while one is down; red: check power, paper and the network cable.

targets.expr: count(max by (tenant, printer_name) (printer_status{deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|unlinked|"}) == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: SD-card errors
panels.description: Most SD-card I/O errors any Pi has seen since boot. Anything above 0 means a dying card: swap in the spare card soon.

panels.title: Hottest Pi
panels.description: Highest SoC temperature across the Pis. Over 70 °C yellow, 80 °C red (throttling): give the Pi air, move it off the oven side.

panels.title: Least free disk
panels.description: Lowest free space on any Pi's data disk. Under 1 GB yellow, 500 MB red: old batches/logs are filling the card.

panels.title: Tablets connected
panels.description: Paired Quibase tablets listening across the selected stores. A store with 0 will not ring — see the table below.

panels.title: Agent versions running
panels.description: Distinct agent versions across the selected Pis. More than 1 (yellow) is normal mid-rollout; for long it means a Pi missed an update — use its Update button.

targets.expr: count(count by (version) ({__name__=~"agent_info(_ratio)?", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|unlinked|"})) or count(count by (service_version) ({__name__=~"agent_disk_free(_bytes)?", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|unlinked|"}))

panels.title: Pis
panels.description: One row per Pi: agent version, last heartbeat, disk, temperature, SD errors, tablets and POS link. Read across a red cell: last seen > 5 min = offline; SD errors > 0 = swap the card; tablets 0 = nothing rings.

targets.expr: max by (tenant, service_instance_id, version) ({__name__=~"agent_info(_ratio)?", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|unlinked|"}) or on (tenant, service_instance_id) max by (tenant, service_instance_id, version) (label_replace({__name__=~"agent_disk_free(_bytes)?", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|unlinked|"}, "version", "$1", "service_version", "(.*)"))
max by (tenant, service_instance_id) (sum by (tenant, service_instance_id, printer_name) (printer_status{deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|unlinked|"}))

panels.title: Printer status
panels.description: Each printer's reachability over time as probed by the Pi. Red stretches are outages (tickets were rerouted); frequent short flips mean a loose cable or a weak network link to that printer.

panels.title: Print failures
panels.description: Print attempts where some ticket printed nowhere, by reason (no_printer / write_error / ticket_failed) and store. Any bar is a ticket the kitchen may not have — check the tablet and resend.

panels.title: Print errors per printer
panels.description: Prints that failed at a specific printer (error / detect_failed). One printer dominating = that printer's hardware or network.

targets.expr: sum by (tenant, printer_name, result) (increase(orders_printed_total{deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|unlinked|", result!="ok"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Printer write time p95
panels.description: TCP write latency to each printer. A printer creeping up toward seconds is about to drop off the network.

panels.title: Reprints & kitchen resends
panels.description: Receipt reprints and kitchen-ticket resends by where they came from. A rise in kitchen_resend means tickets are getting lost (paper out, printer down) — staff are working around a printer problem.

panels.title: SSE reconnects per hour
panels.description: How often each Pi had to reconnect to main. A few per day is normal; a steady stream means the store's internet or main is unstable.

panels.title: Tablets connected
panels.description: Paired tablets on each Pi's live stream. Dropping to 0 during open hours means nothing rang for new orders.

panels.title: POS link
panels.description: Whether each store's hub could reach the SoftTouch POS. Red stretches = POS orders stopped appearing on the tablet; restart quicc-hub on the store box if it stays down.

panels.title: POS status age
panels.description: Seconds since each store's hub last reported to its Pi. Above 5 min (red line) the hub is stuck or off.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: SoC temperature per Pi. Sustained 80 °C (red line) throttles the Pi.

panels.title: Disk free
panels.description: Free bytes on each Pi's data disk. A steady downward slope reaching 500 MB (red line) needs attention before the card fills.

panels.title: SD-card errors
panels.description: SD-card I/O errors since boot per Pi. Any step up means the card is failing — swap in the spare.

panels.title: Pi warnings & errors
panels.description: Warning and error lines from the selected stores' Pis. Printer, SSE and sync problems show up here first; click a TraceID to open the trace.
